findings.title: Non-distance comparability facts lost by the engine's merge
findings.evidence: r6-bypass2.mjs (quality sessions weeks 3-6, work pace 255, effort 7; week 7): athlete HEAT + watch no condition -> [300,335] 0; athlete HEAT + watch conditions ['RAIN'] -> row conditions RAIN, [290,325] +0.03 (534083..); app gpsQuality OK without distance + watch WEARABLE_PARTIAL 9 km POOR -> row 9 km OK, [290,325] +0.03. r6-bypass.mjs row level: walkBreaks true -> false; TREADMILL -> GPS against a WEARABLE_FULL watch. Identical in frozen and patch. Cause: mergeActual keeps one value per field by source rank (first on a tie); reportFactOf keeps only the stop and distance facts.
findings.whyNotBlocking: not E-01 (no whole-row reason hidden), not created or worsened by the patch, outside the authorized scope, needs an integration that sends athlete fields from the device or device fields from the app
findings.whyNotNote: same class as the Founder's rule for this patch; moves a band 10 s/km; the iOS contract avoids it only by omission, with no explicit never and no test
findings.closes: before integration or real athletes: (a) the integration contract states that the device report never carries conditions, walkBreaks or the athlete's surface, and the athlete report never carries gpsQuality or a device measurement, with adapter outcome tests of the four shapes; or (b) SSCTR and Founder decide the Core keeps these facts per report (a runtime change outside this patch, with its own authorization and review)
